qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

**Added from #34859** (2026-11-17T14:10Z, `touched:b914e724`). Full lists are in #34859's proposed close-out as filed by the seat; the summary is below.

## Re-points (stale clauses)
- `platform-core.console-installability-indicators` acceptance[3]: "no service worker on stock". The console's app-shell service worker shipped deliberately with #29155 (`ui/apps/console/src/main.tsx` `syncServiceWorker()`, scope `/_console/`). Re-point the clause and any no-offline-caching docs.
- About 40 checklist-accuracy notes. Among them:
  - builtin-apps-nav-render: Account has 9 leaves;
  - per-group-signoff negative[1]: 404 vs 403;
  - EGRESS_REFUSED needs `OS_EGRESS_ALLOWED_TARGETS=127.0.0.1` for loopback;
  - grid density now lives in the Display popover;
  - the `cli.doctor-deprecation-scan` wording;
  - and others.
  These are listed one per line in the runner report that the seat files on #34859's thread.
- Tier 1 refs: parser-hostile ref spellings (brace lists, bare sibling names, the `objectui:` prefix) in about 18 items; `dashboards.report-measure-drill-scope` names no file; several stale counts (form-dirty-guard 22, mcp-http-surface 17 tools, admin-lifecycle-operations 31 routes).
- Pin health: `attachments-permission-matrix.dogfood` skips its cross-tenant case (g).

## Partial coverage gaps
- 138 Tier 1 PARTIALs are pin-layer gaps. By area: access-security 13, ai 10, api-backend 8, approvals 4, attachments-storage 5, automation 7, cli 5, dashboards 2, i18n 3, identity-auth 15, integration-system 10, platform-core 16, records-forms 19, search 2, studio-authoring 19. The 11 `ui/e2e/live` specs have no runner path in the routine harness.
- 4 pinned P0 items are PARTIAL only for layer: no-active-org-session-semantics, mcp-stdio-fail-closed, query-contract-matrix, v18-boot-refusals. Their live legs PASS in #34803.
- The 14 Tier 2/3 PARTIALs are named one per line in #34859.

qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

**#34859 close-out lists, verbatim from the runner's report** (2026-11-17T14:11Z), as the seat's previous comment points to:

**Named partial gaps:**
- **138 Tier 1 PARTIALs are pin-layer gaps.** By area: access-security 13, ai 10, api-backend 8, approvals 4, attachments-storage 5, automation 7, cli 5, dashboards 2, i18n 3, identity-auth 15, integration-system 10, platform-core 16, records-forms 19, search 2, studio-authoring 19.
  - Proposal: one pin-upgrade card per area, adding HTTP-layer or live-spec pins, or park each area on the wave anchor.
  - Not-run live legs worth naming: the 11 `ui/e2e/live` specs, which have no runner path in this round's harness.
- **14 Tier 2/3 PARTIALs, one named gap each:**
  - `access-security.suggested-binding-loop` negative[0]: no forbidden-bit set was authored.
  - `automation.flow-error-handling` negative[1]: the try region never succeeds on stock fixtures.
  - `ai.console-ai-surface-gating` and `platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface`: no agent catalog in the open edition.
  - `i18n.build-gates-hold` negative[2]: the `--write` arm was not run.
  - `integration-system.webhook-lifecycle` acceptance[2]: #23166.
  - `integration-system.notification-preference-suppression` acceptance[3] (mandatoryTopics) and acceptance[4]: the door that renders `sys_notification_template` is unnamed.
  - `platform-core.shell-nav-personalization`: 5 legs timed out in the driver.
  - `platform-core.console-installability-indicators`: the decision above.
  - `records-forms.grid-personalization`: density after reload and clear-grouping not confirmed.
  - `studio-authoring.held-edit-leave-guard`: 5 Interfaces cells not driven.
  - `studio-authoring.app-and-nav-properties` acceptance[5]: `requiresObject` has no inspector control by design (#30059).
  - `studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix`: 10 of 36 rows not driven.
  - `ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names`: 2 of 11 variants not driven.

**Parked on the wave anchor (checklist accuracy, not extracted):**
- `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render`: Account now has 9 leaves and an AI Assistant group, so "8" is stale.
- `approvals.per-group-signoff` negative[1]: a non-reader gets 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND; only a reader outside the groups gets 403.
- `platform-core.boot-health` steps[3]: the compile advisories never print on `--no-compile` boots.
- `search.rls-both-personas`: steps[3] needs `owner` = the member's email; steps[4] needs at least 3 own rows to page.
- `ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate` acceptance[4]: the 428 confirmation gate answers before the credential gate.
- `platform-core.docs-audience-gate` steps[1]: should name the per-package books.
- `two-factor-verify-to-activate` acceptance[2]: the sqlite DDL default of `verified` is `'1'`.
- `aggregate-contract-matrix` acceptance[3]: the refusal head arrives in `fields[0].message`.
- `migrate-plan-apply-json` steps[8]: `record-currency-codes` needs `--object --field --code`, on `showcase_invoice.amount`.
- `trigger-status-contract` steps[7]: the `/actions` path needs the record id.
- `retired-def-refusal` step 2: entry files no longer record their route.
- `flow-node-type-matrix` knownGaps[1], webhook-lifecycle, flow-error-handling: loopback needs `OS_EGRESS_ALLOWED_TARGETS=127.0.0.1`; the try failure is now `EGRESS_REFUSED`.
- `suggested-binding-loop`: a runtime package with an `isDefault` set works as the pending fixture.
- `cube-query` acceptance[5]: a generic retired-key pointer replaces the specific migration hint.
- `packaged-flow-clone-contract` acceptance[6]: the header chip shows only at wide viewports.
- `session-list-revoke` acceptance[0]: the invite sign-up adds a session, so the list has 3 rows.
- `notification-center` acceptance[5]: the Approvals tab is now an inline list.
- `email-verification-loop`: the set is `showcase_member_default`; SMTP is needed before resend.
- `oauth-app-consent-loop`: the client secret must go as HTTP Basic.
- `linked-accounts-social`: `qa-fixture oidc-stub` answers 501; unlink needs `params.accountId`.
- `sharing-rule-authoring-ui`: body fields are `criteria`, `recipientType`, `recipientId`.
- `app-and-nav-properties`: `contextSelectors` is an array; the second app must be authored after the first.
- `flow-edge-type-authoring`: how to select an edge on the canvas.
- `app-management-toggle`: Delete is a two-click confirm.
- `readonly-package-locks-studio`: add-field-into-pair is a second designed exception.
- `record-page-decisions`: five actions now sit in a "More" overflow.
- `ai.console-ai-surface-gating`: `/ai` renders "unavailable" in place (#26614).
- `i18n.studio-follows-app-locale`: the dashboard-designer URL lands on the nav editor.
- `grid-personalization` steps[1]: density now lives in the Display popover.
- `sso-enforced-first-paint`: `/auth/config` lists no domain-routed provider.
- `console-installability-indicators` steps[0]: read the manifest through CDP.
- `conditional-rules-grid`: the client now blocks the save without a request; INV-1002 seeds one line.
- `sla-escalation` acceptance[4]: the registration door is an equivalent oracle.
- `cli.doctor-deprecation-scan` acceptance[1]: the "removed in #2377" wording is stale.
- `notification-preference-suppression` acceptance[4]: name the template-rendering door.
- Tier 1 refs:
  - Parser-hostile ref spellings (brace lists, bare sibling names, `objectui:` prefix) in about 18 items.
  - `dashboards.report-measure-drill-scope` names no file.
  - `form-dirty-guard` count is now 22.
  - `package-export-round-trip` now boots two showcases.
  - `permission-set-package-resolution`'s first file pins a different door.
  - `mcp-http-surface` says "twelve" tools where acceptance lists 17.
  - `admin-lifecycle-operations` lists 6 routes; the surface is 31.
- Pin health: `attachments-permission-matrix.dogfood` skips its cross-tenant case (g).

qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

**Added from #35091** (2026-11-18T02:39Z, `priority:P0`, the 18.6.0 release-candidate gate, 22 PASS / 2 PARTIAL):

- **`scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs contributor-member` fails at step 3 on this subject.** Reproduced three times independently. The invited sign-up holds no `sys_member` row, so it cannot bind a position (400), which is the invite_only posture RUNNER.md already documents. The script is stale, not the product. The steps prose of four items (owd-sharing-matrix, write-path-guards, crud-permission-matrix, rls-both-sides) still recommends the invite-then-sign-up route; the runner minted personas via `admin/create-user` + `change-password` + a `sys_user_position` POST instead.
- **`access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` acceptance[7]** still says "Red until #24784 lands". It is green at `c21945d2`.
- **`platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` steps[5]** says 8 Account destinations; it is 9 live. The same note is already above, from #34803.
- **`cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`:** its integration pin files run in the default tier, so `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly` selects none of them.
- **Below the filing bar, seen once:** Setup → Audit Log issues `GET /api/v1/data/sys_jwks?...` and gets 404, because `sys_jwks` has `apiEnabled: false`. The row reads "JWKS Key · record unavailable". Re-check in the next browser round before filing.
